title: Special Parking Regulations for Flood-resistant Buildings
previewText: The provisions of this Section, inclusive, are optional, and are only applicable to zoning lots located wholly or partially within flood zones. The provisions of this Section, inclusive, may apply to zoning lots containing flood-resistant buildings.
